name: radial-array-simple
description: Ladder for the radial/polar array feature (PC-ARRAY-RADIAL). Rungs: (1) verify hidden in Simple mode; (2) verify visible in Pro mode; (3) place a dining table + one chair inside the livingDining room, fire radial array via store action, screenshot top + perspective to verify 6 chairs evenly spaced around the table facing center.

Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).
